notes: Generic circular piezo + LED-ring hit target defaults. Device identity is generated at runtime from the ESP32 eFuse MAC; do not create numbered target IDs. Secrets are not needed for the initial USB-serial firmware. Hardware defaults are migrated from the wall-mounted target bench sketch in origin/HeavyBlaster_HWsystem_test (LED GPIO18, 60 LED WS2812B/GRB ring, piezo DO GPIO27) with optional analog peak capture when an AO wire is added. HP is phase based: hp_phase_count colors, hits_per_phase hits per color, and max_hits must equal hp_phase_count * hits_per_phase. The current default is green 5 hits, yellow 5 hits, red 5 hits. Phase 1/2 missing HP can show a dim next-phase backfill with black gap LEDs at both circular boundaries. On phase-transition hits, the existing dim next-phase rear arc stays visible while the final removed segment wipe completes. HP=0 is treated as a separate defeat moment: after the final white flash, the last HP chunk wipes away, a short blackout beat confirms HP=0, then a rainbow gradient sweep plays once and the target blacks out. AO sensitivity is controlled by hit_threshold/hit_rearm_threshold. DO-only sensitivity is controlled mostly by digital_hit_min_edges and digital_isr_debounce_us; the default keeps two-edge noise filtering but lowers debounce to catch quicker piezo ringing. Timing values are gameplay tuning values. BOOT/GPIO0 long-press can initialize/reset the target after firmware has booted.
